summary: Retrospective closure of a completed historical pipeline with a retention-coverage limitation. All three 92160-transition trials and 63 frozen reports exist; all 189 evaluated episodes passed at tails32,36,40,44,48,52,60 with matching checkpoint hashes and no reported recovery. The historical comparator accepted its explicitly evaluated boundaries. However the trained window also includes tail56, which has no final evaluation. Full training-window retention claimed by the component design is not proven; do not promote based on that broader claim. Preserve the historical passing summary unchanged and record this more limited conclusion. Controls and observation identity have since changed; current corrected-control transfer is tested separately in EXP-0043 rather than presenting a present-day replay as missing historical evidence.
